status: All 142 explicit findings and 12 additional rating reservations have scoped responses; all nine correction clusters are validated. Original participant reports, ratings and outputs remain unchanged.

round4:active_gesture_caption.title: Explain the active tool gesture beside the canvas
round4:active_gesture_caption.response: Show concise contextual instructions when a tool is selected, including the clip click required by Duplicate; retain immediate context-menu commands.
round4:active_gesture_caption.acceptance: Choosing Duplicate exposes its gesture without opening Help; clicking a clip still duplicates, and changing tools keeps the music unchanged.

round4:numeric_pad.title: Exact numeric values using only the mouse
round4:numeric_pad.response: Add the shared numeric pad to timing/tempo fields and generator fields; preserve precise values, Apply/Cancel and Undo semantics. Generator Start/Length retain their intentional whole-bar constraint and reject fractions.
round4:numeric_pad.acceptance: Enter exact values by mouse without forced repeated stepping or a hidden drag requirement: clip/tempo/loop fields accept fractional values within their domains; generator Start/Length accept whole bars and visibly reject fractional input.

round4:stable_generator_actions.title: Keep generator actions fixed after an addition
round4:stable_generator_actions.response: Reserve feedback space and stable Add notes / Next range action geometry as generator status changes.
round4:stable_generator_actions.acceptance: Repeated additions and range advances remain reachable at the same pointer coordinates after the first addition; note edits and Undo remain correct.

round4:explicit_retry_playback.title: Expose recovery as Retry playback
round4:explicit_retry_playback.response: Offer a visible retry action after a terminal output failure, rebuilding the failed engine at the current cursor. Preserve the backend cause and avoid automatic retry.
round4:explicit_retry_playback.acceptance: The visible action creates a fresh healthy stream without project/history changes and remains separate from nonfatal dropout notices. Actual ALSA EIO remains a platform/backend limitation, not claimed eliminated.

round4:recent_exports.title: Keep recent WAV and MIDI results visible together
round4:recent_exports.response: Retain separate recent export results and paths so a later MIDI completion cannot hide whether WAV export completed.
round4:recent_exports.acceptance: Sequential WAV/MIDI exports retain both outcomes and destinations; ongoing or failed work remains accurately distinguished from success.

round5:precise_edge_drag.title: Immediate short clip-edge corrections
round5:precise_edge_drag.response: Use shared drag-only targets on real clip edges so sub6pixel corrections and the final release endpoint are applied, with zero-motion, source-bound, group, fade, snap and single-Undo guards. Preserve body-click selection and group dragging.
round5:precise_edge_drag.acceptance: Short audio/MIDI edge drags apply their final snapped/free position; an unmoved edge press does not edit; group/body/fade behavior and one Undo per gesture remain correct.

round5:midi_release_position.title: Apply the final MIDI pointer position on release
round5:midi_release_position.response: Process the final released-frame pointer location for active MIDI gestures as well as button-down updates, with a regression that distinguishes the before/after behavior.
round5:midi_release_position.acceptance: A running-app before/after scenario demonstrates the dropped final-position bug and its correction. This addresses a confirmed code path consistent with P4, while the exact cause of that native participant gesture remains unproven.

round5:loop_and_clip_identity.title: Clarify playback looping and repeated clip identity
round5:loop_and_clip_identity.response: Use explicit Loop playback over clip/selection/arrangement wording and clarify that Repeat creates copies. Extend the existing full-name hover with track and start/end position so equally named repeated clips can be distinguished.
round5:loop_and_clip_identity.acceptance: Visible wording separates playback range from clip creation; hover identifies full clip/track name and exact location without changing project/history.

round6:duration_mode_bounds.title: Show and enforce the real duration range for the chosen mode
round6:duration_mode_bounds.response: Shared duration controls and the numeric keypad now derive mode-specific bounds from the current source window, intersected with the remaining timeline. Stretch preserves the existing 25%–400% source-speed constraint; invalid drafts remain editable and cannot be applied.
round6:duration_mode_bounds.acceptance: For an unstretched 4-beat pattern, Stretch exposes its valid 1–16 beat duration range; 56 beats is rejected before Apply and 16 beats succeeds. Mode switches, source-rate changes, valid fractional values, no-op/cancel and Undo retain correct semantics.
round6:duration_mode_bounds.score_policy: This correction follows the frozen round6 reports. Scores are not revised, and no additional fresh participant round is claimed.
